exercises.instructionUz: Suratlar bolalar uyda duch kelishi mumkin bo'lgan baxtsiz hodisalar sabablarini ko'rsatadi. Ularni ro'yxatdagi natijalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SABAB → NATIJA.

  A hot water → scald themselves
  B swimming pool → fall in and
     drown
  C stairs → fall and hurt themselves
  D electrical sockets → get an
     electric shock
  E knife → cut themselves
  F matches → burn themselves
  G cleaning products → drink them
     and poison themselves


⚠ 'THEMSELVES':

  = o'zlarini (o'zlik olmoshi,
  ko'plik).
  ⚠ 10-unit mavzusi - 71-betda.


⚠ 'TO SCALD' va 'TO BURN':

  scald = qaynoq SUV/BUG' bilan
     kuydirmoq
  burn = OLOV/issiq narsa bilan
     kuydirmoq


⚠ 'TO POISON':

  = zaharlamoq.
  ⚠ 'poison' (ot) = zahar;
  'poisonous' = zaharli (68-bet).


⚠ 'AN ELECTRIC SHOCK':

  = tok urishi.
  ⚠ 'to get an electric shock' =
  tok urmoq.


⚠ 'A CAUSE' va 'A RESULT':

  cause = sabab; result = natija.


⚠ 'TO STICK TO THE RULES':

  = qoidalarga rioya qilmoq
  (unit nomi).

  (ehtimol).

  'could' - imkoniyat bor.

⚠ 'TO LET SB DO':

  = kimgadir ruxsat bermoq.
  ⚠ 'let' dan keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l:
  "Don't let children PLAY".

⚠ 'NOT IN USE':

  = ishlatilmayotgan.


⚠ 'A POND':

  = hovuz (kichik, tabiiy).
  ⚠ 'a pool' = basseyn.

XAVFSIZLIK VARAQASI - TO'LIQ MATNI
VA TARJIMASI.


⚠ TUZILIShI:

  Har band = BUYRUQ (imperative) +
  SABAB (might/could + natija).


⚠ 10-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI:

  BUYRUQ MAYLI: Keep, put, Never
     allow, Make sure, Never let,
     Fit, Put
  MODAL FE'LLAR: might, could
  O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI: themselves
  MAJHUL: 'are injured', 'could be
     prevented'

tasks.en: Is Your Home A Safe Place For Your Kids?
Every year, thousands of children are injured in accidents in the home - accidents that could be prevented. Read this leaflet and make sure that similar accidents don't happen to your children.
tasks.uz: Har yili minglab bolalar uydagi baxtsiz hodisalarda jarohatlanadi - bu hodisalarning oldini olish mumkin edi. Bu varaqani o'qing va shunga o'xshash hodisalar bolalaringiz bilan sodir bo'lmasligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'are injured', 'could be prevented' -
majhul nisbat.
⚠ 'to happen TO sb' = kimdir bilan sodir
bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: Keep all cleaning products in a safe place. Your children might drink them and poison themselves.
tasks.uz: Barcha tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlang. Bolalaringiz ularni ichib zaharlanishi mumkin.

tasks.en: Always put knives and other sharp objects away after use. Your children could cut themselves.
tasks.uz: Pichoq va boshqa o'tkir narsalarni ishlatgandan keyin har doim joyiga qo'ying. Bolalaringiz o'zini kesib olishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'put ... away' = joyiga qo'ymoq.
⚠ 'after use' = ishlatgandan keyin.

tasks.en: Never allow your children to play with pots and pans on the stove. They could scald themselves.
tasks.uz: Bolalaringizga plitadagi qozon-tovalar bilan o'ynashga hech qachon ruxsat bermang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'allow sb TO do'.
⚠ 'scald' = qaynoq suyuqlik bilan kuymoq.

tasks.en: Make sure you cover electrical sockets when they are not in use. Your children could give themselves an electric shock.
tasks.uz: Rozetkalar ishlatilmayotganda ularni yopganingizga ishonch hosil qiling. Bolalaringizni tok urishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'give themselves an electric shock' =
o'zini tok urdirmoq.

tasks.en: Never let your children play with matches. They might start a fire and burn themselves.
tasks.uz: Bolalaringizni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular yong'in chiqarib o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'let sb do' - 'to' siz.
⚠ 'to start a fire' = yong'in chiqarmoq.

tasks.en: Fit safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs. Your children could fall and hurt themselves.
tasks.uz: Zinaning yuqori va pastki qismiga xavfsizlik to'siqlarini o'rnating. Bolalaringiz yiqilib jarohatlanishi mumkin.

tasks.en: Three news reports
[A-1] Six-year-old Pamela Kinsey nearly drowned in a pond in Carlton Park, Coddleton, yesterday afternoon.

tasks.en: [A-2] The accident occurred at 3:30 pm as Pamela and her nine-year-old brother were playing at the edge of the pond. When his sister fell into the pond, Kyle, who cannot swim, ran to get help. He was afraid she would drown. Fortunately, the park warden managed to save little Pamela.
tasks.uz: [A-2] Hodisa soat 15:30 da Pamela va to'qqiz yoshli akasi hovuz chekkasida o'ynayotganida sodir bo'ldi. Singlisi hovuzga tushib ketganda, suzishni bilmaydigan Kyle yordam chaqirgani yugurdi. U singlisi cho'kib ketishidan qo'rqdi. Baxtiga, bog' qo'riqchisi kichkina Pamelani qutqarishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to occur' = sodir bo'lmoq (rasmiy).
⚠ 'a park warden' = bog' qo'riqchisi.
⚠ 'managed to' = muvaffaq bo'ldi.
⚠ BATAFSIL xatboshi.

tasks.en: [A-3] Since the accident, Coddleton Council has put up a high fence around the pond. Local police are warning parents not to let young children play alone near water.

tasks.note:

⚠ 'warn sb NOT TO do' = qilmaslikka
ogohlantirmoq.
⚠ ChORA xatboshi.

tasks.en: [B] 42-year-old Marcus Hirst was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning. Mr Hirst was on a day trip to the beach with his wife and two young children when he decided to climb the cliffs in search of birds' eggs.
tasks.uz: [B] 42 yoshli Marcus Hirst kecha ertalab Dover yaqinidagi plyajda qoyalarga yiqilib jarohatlandi. Janob Hirst rafiqasi va ikki yosh bolasi bilan plyajga bir kunlik sayohatga chiqqan edi, u qush tuxumlarini qidirib qoyalarga chiqishga qaror qildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a day trip' = bir kunlik sayohat.
⚠ 'in search of' = ... ni qidirib (55-bet).

tasks.en: He fell from a height of about twelve metres onto the rocks below. His wife called the ambulance service on her mobile phone and Mr Hirst was taken to hospital in a Coastguard helicopter. He had a broken leg and arm, but suffered no other injuries.
tasks.uz: U taxminan o'n ikki metr balandlikdan pastdagi qoyalarga yiqildi. Rafiqasi mobil telefonidan tez yordam xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qildi va janob Hirst qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmatining vertolyotida kasalxonaga olib borildi. Uning oyog'i va qo'li singan edi, lekin boshqa jarohat olmadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a height' = balandlik.
⚠ 'to suffer injuries' = jarohat olmoq.
⚠ 'was taken to hospital' - majhul, artiklsiz.

tasks.en: Since the accident, the Coastguard has put up signs on the beach warning people not to climb the cliffs.
tasks.uz: Hodisadan beri qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati plyajga odamlarni qoyalarga chiqmaslikka ogohlantiruvchi belgilar o'rnatdi.

tasks.en: [C] Robert Blakewell, a twenty-year-old student from Sussex, was trapped in a deep snowdrift in the French Alps on Tuesday. Robert was on holiday with some college friends at an Albertville ski resort when he decided to go skiing alone and away from the main slopes of the resort.
tasks.uz: [C] Sasseksdan yigirma yoshli talaba Robert Blakewell seshanba kuni Fransiya Alp tog'larida chuqur qor uyumida qamalib qoldi. Robert kollej do'stlari bilan Albertville chang'i kurortida ta'tilda edi, u yolg'iz, kurortning asosiy qiyaliklaridan uzoqda chang'i uchishga qaror qildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a snowdrift' = qor uyumi.
⚠ 'a ski resort' = chang'i kurorti.
⚠ 'away from' = ... dan uzoqda.

tasks.en: His friends contacted the authorities when Robert failed to return that evening. A mountain rescue team managed to find Robert and take him to the nearest hospital.
tasks.uz: Robert o'sha kuni kechqurun qaytmagach, do'stlari rasmiy idoralarga murojaat qilishdi. Tog' qutqaruv jamoasi Robertni topib, eng yaqin kasalxonaga olib borishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'the authorities' = rasmiy idoralar.
⚠ 'to fail to do' = qila olmaslik.

tasks.en: After the accident, the Mountain Rescue Service released a statement to the press, asking skiers not to ski on unmarked slopes.
tasks.uz: Hodisadan keyin Tog' qutqaruv xizmati matbuotga bayonot berib, chang'ichilardan belgilanmagan qiyaliklarda uchmaslikni so'radi.
tasks.note:

⚠ 'the press' = matbuot.

tasks.en: Rules of Diving (safety leaflet).
Never dive alone. If you dive alone, you won't have anyone to help you if there's a problem.
tasks.uz: Hech qachon yolg'iz sho'ng'imang. Agar yolg'iz sho'ng'isangiz, muammo bo'lganda sizga yordam beradigan hech kim bo'lmaydi.

tasks.en: Always mark the place where you are diving with a flag. If you don't, a boat might hit you.
tasks.uz: Sho'ng'iyotgan joyingizni har doim bayroq bilan belgilang. Agar belgilamasangiz, qayiq sizni urib ketishi mumkin.

tasks.en: Never panic if you see a shark. If you do panic, it could attack you.
tasks.uz: Akulani ko'rsangiz hech qachon vahimaga tushmang. Agar vahimaga tushsangiz, u sizga hujum qilishi mumkin.

tasks.en: Make sure you check your equipment carefully before you dive. If you don't, you might have serious problems while you are underwater.
tasks.uz: Sho'ng'ishdan oldin jihozlaringizni albatta diqqat bilan tekshiring. Agar tekshirmasangiz, suv ostida jiddiy muammolarga duch kelishingiz mumkin.

tasks.en: Never dive when you are ill or tired. If you do, you might not have enough energy to save yourself in a dangerous situation.
tasks.uz: Kasal yoki charchagan paytingizda hech qachon sho'ng'imang. Agar sho'ng'isangiz, xavfli vaziyatda o'zingizni qutqarish uchun yetarli kuchingiz bo'lmasligi mumkin.

tasks.en: Make sure you check your air supply regularly while you are underwater. If you don't, you could run out of air and drown.
tasks.uz: Suv ostida havo zaxirangizni muntazam tekshirib turing. Agar tekshirmasangiz, havongiz tugab, cho'kib ketishingiz mumkin.
tasks.note: ⚠ 'run out of air' = havo tugab qolmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ MAYLI (THE IMPERATIVE).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
     (ega YO'Q):
     'Put a fence around any ponds.'
     'Keep cleaning products in a
      safe place.'

  INKOR: DON'T + fe'l:
     "Don't let your children play
      with matches."
  ⚠ 'NEVER' + fe'l - kuchli inkor:
     'Never allow ...'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Odamlarga NIMA QILISh / QILMASLIKNI
  aytish: buyruq, ko'rsatma,
  ogohlantirish, maslahat, taklif.

  ⚠ 'Please' bilan muloyimroq:
  'Please close the door.'


⚠ 'YOU' AYTILMAYDI:

  ✗ 'You put a fence.'
  ✓ 'Put a fence.'


⚠ 'ALWAYS' va 'NEVER' BILAN:

  'ALWAYS put knives away.'
  'NEVER let children play with
   matches.'

tasks.en: Imperative — Use
We use the imperative to tell people what to do/not to do.
tasks.uz: Buyruq maylini odamlarga nima qilish/qilmaslikni aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI (REFLEXIVE
PRONOUNS).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLLARI                       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I     → myself
  you   → yourself (birlik)
  he    → himself
  she   → herself
  it    → itself
  we    → ourselves
  you   → yourselves (ko'plik)
  they  → themselves

  ⚠ Birlik '-self', ko'plik
  '-selves'.
  ⚠ 'hisself', 'theirselves' - XATO!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  EGA va TO'LDIRUVChI BIR ODAM/NARSA
  bo'lganda:

  'They might cut THEMSELVES.'
  (ular o'zlarini kesadi)

  'He hurt HIMSELF.' - o'zini
  'He hurt HIM.' - boshqa odamni

  ⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin to'ldiruvchi
  ShART: 'They enjoyed themselves.'

tasks.en: Reflexive Pronouns — Use
We use reflexive pronouns when the subject and the object of the verb refer to the same person or thing.

╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ⚠ Kontekst ochib beradi.

tasks.en: Might/Could — Use

exercises.explanationUz:
MAJBURIYaT VA TAQIQ.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HAVE TO = ZARURAT               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'You HAVE TO buy a ticket before
   getting on the train.'
  ⚠ Tashqi qoida, zarurat.
  ⚠ he/she/it → HAS TO.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  DON'T HAVE TO = ShART EMAS      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "You DON'T HAVE TO help me wash
   the car." (xohlasang - qilasan)
  ⚠ TAQIQ EMAS! Faqat 'kerak emas'.
  ⚠ he/she → DOESN'T HAVE TO.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUST = JUDA KUChLI MASLAHAT     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'You MUST stay away from the
   boats.' (juda muhim)
  ⚠ Gapiruvchining O'Z fikri.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUSTN'T = TAQIQ                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "You MUSTN'T go near the rocks."
  (juda muhim - bormaslik)
  "You MUSTN'T steal." (qonun
   taqiqlaydi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG KATTA XATO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DON'T HAVE TO ≠ MUSTN'T

  "You don't have to come." =
     kelishing shart emas (xohlasang
     kel)
  "You mustn't come." = kelma!
     (taqiq)

  ⚠ O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'kerak
  emas' deb tarjima qilinishi
  mumkin - DIQQAT!


⚠ 'MUST' O'TGAN ZAMONI YO'Q:

  → 'had to' ishlatiladi.
  'I HAD TO buy a ticket yesterday.'


⚠ 'ILLEGAL':

  = noqonuniy.
  ⚠ 'legal' = qonuniy.


⚠ 'PROHIBITION':

  = taqiq.

tasks.en: Have to/don't have to - Must/mustn't — Use
tasks.uz: Have to/don't have to - Must/mustn't — Ishlatilishi

tasks.en: We use have to to express necessity. You have to buy a ticket before getting on the train.
tasks.uz: 'have to' ni zaruratni ifodalash uchun ishlatamiz. Poyezdga chiqishdan oldin chipta sotib olishingiz kerak.

tasks.en: We use do not have to to say that it is not necessary for something to happen. You don't have to help me wash the car. (... but you can if you want to.)
tasks.uz: 'do not have to' ni biror narsa zarur emasligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Mashina yuvishga yordam berishing shart emas. (... lekin xohlasang, bo'ladi.)

tasks.en: We can use must/mustn't to express very strong advice. You must stay away from the boats. You mustn't go near the rocks.
tasks.uz: 'must/mustn't' ni juda kuchli maslahat uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin. Qayiqlardan uzoq turishingiz shart. Qoyalarga yaqin bormasligingiz shart.

tasks.en: We also use mustn't to express prohibition. You mustn't steal from other people. (It's illegal.)
tasks.uz: 'mustn't' ni taqiqni ifodalash uchun ham ishlatamiz. Boshqalardan o'g'irlik qilish mumkin emas. (Bu noqonuniy.)

exercises.explanationUz:
RUXSAT: CAN va BE ALLOWED TO.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  CAN / CAN'T                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ruxsat SO'RASh, BERISh, RAD ETISh:
  "Can I go out?" - "Of course you
   can."
  "I'm afraid you can't enter this
   room."
  ⚠ Ruxsat GAPIRUVChIga bog'liq.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  BE ALLOWED TO                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = ruxsat berilgan bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ Ruxsat QOIDAga bog'liq,
  gapiruvchiga EMAS.

  'Can I play in the garden?'
     = Sen menga ruxsat berasanmi?
  'Am I allowed to use the
   telephone?'
     = Qoida bo'yicha mumkinmi?


⚠ ShAKLI:

  am/is/are + allowed to + fe'l
  'You aren't allowed to park here.'
  'Are we allowed to smoke?'


⚠ 'TO ALLOW':

  = ruxsat bermoq.
  ⚠ 'allow sb TO do' (70-bet).


⚠ 'PERMISSION':

  = ruxsat (ot).
  ⚠ 'to ask for permission' = ruxsat
  so'ramoq.

tasks.en: Can - Be allowed to — Use
We use can to ask for or give permission, and can't to refuse permission. "Can I go out?" "Of course you can." I'm afraid you can't enter this room.
tasks.uz: 'can' ni ruxsat so'rash yoki berish, 'can't' ni rad etish uchun ishlatamiz. "Chiqsam bo'ladimi?" "Albatta." Afsuski, bu xonaga kira olmaysiz.

tasks.en: We use be allowed to to ask for, give or refuse permission. The permission, however, does not depend on the speaker.
tasks.uz: 'be allowed to' ni ruxsat so'rash, berish yoki rad etish uchun ishlatamiz. Lekin ruxsat gapiruvchiga bog'liq emas.

tasks.en: Can I play in the garden? (Will you allow me to play in the garden?) / Am I allowed to use the telephone? (What is the rule?)
tasks.uz: Bog'da o'ynasam bo'ladimi? (Sen ruxsat berasanmi?) / Telefondan foydalanishga ruxsat bormi? (Qoida qanday?)

exercises.explanationUz:
O'TGAN ZAMONDA MAJBURIYaT VA RUXSAT.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HAD TO / DIDN'T HAVE TO         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = 'have to' / 'don't have to'
  ning O'TGAN ZAMONI.

  'When my father was a boy, he HAD
   TO wear shorts to school.'
  "Children DIDN'T HAVE TO learn
   about computers twenty years
   ago."

  ⚠ 'must' ning o'tgan zamoni YO'Q -
  'had to' ishlatiladi!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  COULD / COULDN'T                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = 'can' / 'can't' ning O'TGAN
  ZAMONI (ruxsat, imkoniyat).

  'I COULD go to parties when I was
   17, but I COULDN'T go on my own;
   I HAD TO go with my brother.'


⚠ SAVOL ShAKLLARI:

  DID you HAVE TO ...?
  COULD you ...?


⚠ 'ON MY OWN':

  = yolg'iz o'zim.
  ⚠ 'by myself' bilan bir xil.


⚠ 'TWENTY YEARS AGO':

  = yigirma yil oldin.
  ⚠ 'ago' - vaqtdan KEYIN.

tasks.en: Could and couldn't are the past forms of can and can't.

  must /mʌst/, mustn't /mʌsnt/

  must → /məs/ yoki /məst/

  gap OXIRIDA - KUChLI.
  ⚠ 'can' ham shunday: /kən/ va
  /kæn/.


⚠ /ə/ - SCHWA:

  Eng qisqa, neytral unli.
  Urg'usiz bo'g'inlarda.

╔══════════════════════════════════╗

  "I haven't seen it." - 'Neither
   HAVE I.'


⚠ XATO:

  'Me too' - so'zlashuvda bo'ladi,
  lekin 'So do I' to'g'riroq.
  'I also' - XATO!

╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh XATBOShI                    ║

⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  PAST TENSES (past simple, past
  continuous); chora uchun present
  perfect ('has put up').

  tortadigan.

tasks.en: When we write a news report we can divide it into three paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Yangilik xabarini yozganda uni uch xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we write a short summary of the event. We write about who was involved, what happened, and where and when it happened.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida voqeaning qisqacha mazmunini yozamiz. Kim ishtirok etgani, nima bo'lgani, qayerda va qachon bo'lgani haqida yozamiz.

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we write a detailed description of what happened.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida nima bo'lganining batafsil tavsifini yozamiz.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph we write what action has been taken.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida qanday chora ko'rilganini yozamiz.

tasks.en: We normally use past tenses in this type of writing. We always give our report an eye-catching title.
tasks.uz: Bunday yozuvda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz. Xabarimizga har doim diqqatni tortadigan sarlavha beramiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't let / Never let children + FE'L. They might/could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never let children play with matches. They could burn themselves.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bolalarni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Why should we [maslahat]? - Because children might [natija].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why should we keep cleaning products in a safe place? - Because children might drink them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashimiz kerak? - Chunki bolalar ichib qo'yishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Make sure you + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Make sure you cover electrical sockets when they are not in use.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Rozetkalar ishlatilmayotganda ularni yopganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

sentencePatterns.formula: [FE'L] + ... (buyruq). / Don't + FE'L ... / Never + FE'L ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Keep all cleaning products in a safe place. Never let your children play with matches.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlang. Bolalarni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] might/could + FE'L + [o'zlik olmoshi].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Your children could cut themselves.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bolalaringiz o'zini kesib olishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't [fe'l]! You'll + FE'L + yourself!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't touch the fire! You'll burn yourself!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Olovga tegma! Kuyib qolasan!

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] might/could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom could fall out of the tree.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom daraxtdan tushib ketishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Never/Always + FE'L. - Why? - You might + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never play with burning candles. - Why? - You might start a fire.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yonayotgan sham bilan hech qachon o'ynama. - Nega? - Yong'in chiqarishing mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] has to / doesn't have to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Chris has to get up early. Anne doesn't have to wear a uniform.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chris erta turishi kerak. Anne forma kiyishi shart emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you have to + FE'L? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you have to wear a school uniform? - No, I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maktab formasini kiyishing kerakmi? - Yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: You must / mustn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must keep cleaning products in a safe place. You mustn't let children play with matches.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashingiz shart. Bolalarni gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymasligingiz shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I ...? - No, I'm afraid not. You aren't allowed to ... You have to ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I park my car here? - No, I'm afraid not. You aren't allowed to park here. You have to park somewhere else.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashinani shu yerga qo'ysam bo'ladimi? - Afsuski, yo'q. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin emas. Boshqa joyga qo'yishingiz kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: When [kim] was [yosh], [kim] had to / couldn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When my father was a boy, he had to wear shorts to school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otam bola bo'lganida maktabga shortik kiyishi kerak edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Did they have to ...? - Yes, they did. / Could they ...? - No, they couldn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did they have to wear their best clothes? - Yes, they did.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular eng yaxshi kiyimlarini kiyishi kerakmidi? - Ha.

sentencePatterns.formula: Taxi drivers must / mustn't / don't have to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Taxi drivers mustn't be rude to passengers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Taksi haydovchilari yo'lovchilarga qo'pol bo'lmasligi shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Yosh]-year-old [Ism] was injured when [voqea] [qayerda] [qachon].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: 42-year-old Marcus Hirst was injured when he fell onto rocks on a beach near Dover yesterday morning.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] was + -ING when [ega] decided to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Robert was on holiday when he decided to go skiing alone.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Robert ta'tilda edi, yolg'iz chang'i uchishga qaror qildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Since the accident, [kim] has + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Since the accident, the Coastguard has put up signs on the beach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hodisadan beri qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati plyajga belgilar o'rnatdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] managed to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The park warden managed to save little Pamela.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog' qo'riqchisi kichkina Pamelani qutqarishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I have to ... - So do I. / I don't have to ... - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have to wash the car. - So do I. I don't have to do the gardening. - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashina yuvishim kerak. - Men ham. Bog'da ishlashim shart emas. - Men ham.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] was injured when [nima] attacked [kim] while [kim] was [qayerda].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Carolyn Jenkins was injured when a lion attacked her while she was on safari.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Carolyn Jenkins safarida bo'lganida sher hujumidan jarohatlandi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] has warned [kim] not to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Tourist Board has warned tourists not to approach wild animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Turizm boshqarmasi turistlarni yovvoyi hayvonlarga yaqinlashmaslikka ogohlantirdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Never / Don't + FE'L ... when I'm not around.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never use sharp scissors when I'm not around.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men yo'g'imda hech qachon o'tkir qaychi ishlatma.

sentencePatterns.formula: Make sure you + FE'L before + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Make sure you look right and left before crossing the road.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'ldan o'tishdan oldin albatta o'ngga va chapga qara.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't ... You might + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't play with those scissors. You might cut yourself.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qaychi bilan o'ynama. O'zingni kesib olishing mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She might/could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She might fall into the pool.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U basseynga tushib ketishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: You must + FE'L. / You mustn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must wear a helmet. You mustn't be late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dubulg'a kiyishingiz shart. Kech qolmasligingiz kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: X has to + FE'L. / X doesn't have to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Nicole has to do the washing-up. Jim doesn't have to do the ironing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nikol idish yuvishi kerak. Jim dazmol qilishi shart emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ has to - kerak, doesn't have to - shart emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I ...? - No, you aren't allowed to ..., but you can ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I turn left here? - No, you aren't allowed to turn left here, but you can turn left down the next street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda chapga bursam bo'ladimi? - Yo'q, bu yerda ruxsat yo'q, lekin keyingi ko'chada chapga burilishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't ... You might/could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't park your car here. You could get a parking ticket.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashinangizni bu yerga qo'ymang. Jarima olishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: I did it myself. / He fixed it himself.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I made it myself.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni o'zim tikdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: X had to + FE'L. Y didn't have to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mark had to go to the supermarket. Julie didn't have to.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mark supermarketga borishi kerak edi. Juli borishi shart emas edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When I was five, I could ..., but I couldn't ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I was five, I could sing, but I couldn't swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda qo'shiq ayta olardim, lekin suza olmasdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I have to ... - So do I. / I don't have to ... - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't have to go to my piano lesson. - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pianino darsiga borishim shart emas. - Men ham.

sentencePatterns.formula: Always + FE'L ... If you don't, you could/might + NATIJA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Always check the weather forecast. If you don't, you could sail into a storm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har doim ob-havo ma'lumotini tekshiring. Aks holda bo'ronga duch kelishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Never + FE'L ... If you do, you could/might + NATIJA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never sail close to rocks. If you do, you could destroy your boat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hech qachon qoyalarga yaqin suzmang. Aks holda qayig'ingizni buzishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: Make sure you + FE'L + carefully before you + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Make sure you check your equipment carefully before you dive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sho'ng'ishdan oldin jihozlaringizni albatta diqqat bilan tekshiring.

sentencePatterns.formula: I have to ... - So do I, but I don't have to ... - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have to go to the bank. - So do I, but I don't have to go shopping. - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bankka borishim kerak. - Men ham, lekin xarid qilishim shart emas. - Men ham.
